facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on P-3220 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 1 January 2026 an incident occurred on P-3220 and M-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
